---
title: "Sampling-to-first-report turnaround"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Turnaround is the calendar-day difference between the recorded sample date and
the first report-availability date. Missing or invalid date pairs are excluded
from the turnaround distribution and counted explicitly; no follow-up month
classification is introduced.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_turnaround"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "turnaround-summary.parquet")
values_path <- file.path(result_dir, "turnaround-values.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "turnaround-distribution.svg")
ctdna_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
if (!file.exists(ctdna_path)) stop("Turnaround analysis requires the built ctDNA sample table.")
input_paths <- c(ctdna_path, private_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"))
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(summary_path, values_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "07-turnaround.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  turnaround_summary <- read_result_table(summary_path)
} else {
  samples <- read_result_table(ctdna_path)
  require_public_columns(samples, c("sample_id", "sample_date"), "turnaround")
  report_col <- intersect(c("report_date", "analysis_date"), names(samples))[1L]
  if (is.na(report_col)) {
    stop("Turnaround requires the first report-availability date (`report_date` or `analysis_date`).")
  }
  sample_dates <- parse_analysis_date(samples$sample_date, "sample_date")
  report_dates <- parse_analysis_date(samples[[report_col]], report_col)
  turnaround_days <- as.numeric(report_dates - sample_dates)
  turnaround_days[!is.na(turnaround_days) & turnaround_days < 0] <- NA_real_
  values <- data.frame(turnaround_days = turnaround_days[is.finite(turnaround_days)],
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n_total <- nrow(samples)
  n_valid <- nrow(values)
  turnaround_summary <- data.frame(
    report_date_field = report_col,
    n_samples = n_total,
    n_valid_date_pairs = n_valid,
    n_excluded_missing_or_invalid = n_total - n_valid,
    median_days = if (n_valid == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::median(values$turnaround_days),
    q1_days = if (n_valid == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(values$turnaround_days, 0.25),
    q3_days = if (n_valid == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(values$turnaround_days, 0.75),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write_module_table(turnaround_summary, summary_path)
  write_module_table(values, values_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the turnaround figure.")
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(values, ggplot2::aes(turnaround_days)) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Calendar days from sample to first report", y = "Samples") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built", unit = "calendar_days"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "07-turnaround.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: turnaround-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Sampling-to-report turnaround summary"

turnaround_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
